description: Example template demonstrating ElevenLabs voice configuration parameters

task_messages.content:
Greet the customer warmly:
"Hello {customer_name}! Your order #{order_id} has been confirmed. Would you like me to share the order details?"

role_messages.content:
You are a friendly customer service representative.

IMPORTANT: This template demonstrates ElevenLabs voice configuration:
- Voice ID: Custom voice for this template
- Model: eleven_flash_v2_5 (low-latency model)
- Speed: 1.2 (slightly faster for efficiency)
- Language: en (English TTS)

These settings override the global Redis defaults for this specific template.

Speak naturally in English. Keep responses concise and friendly.
